title: Makefile: localunit skips every package under pkg/bindings
body:
The `localunit` target currently passes `pkg/bindings` in its
`--skip-package` list when invoking Ginkgo.

Since the skip pattern is matched as a substring, this ends up skipping
all packages under `pkg/bindings`, rather than just `pkg/bindings/test`.
The latter appears to be the intended exclusion, since that suite requires
a running Podman service.

This also means that the unit tests in the following packages are not
being run in CI:

- `pkg/bindings` — 14 tests in `connection_stdio_test.go`
- `pkg/bindings/internal/util` — 13 tests in `util_test.go`
- `pkg/bindings/images` — 3 tests in `build_test.go`

While looking into this, I also found that
`TestConvertAdditionalBuildContexts` in
`pkg/bindings/images/build_test.go` fails on a regular Linux host. The test
expects `C:\test` to be converted to `/mnt/c/test`, but
`specgen.ConvertWinMountPath` only performs this conversion when
`shouldResolveWinPaths()` is true. On Linux, that is limited to WSL or
Hyper-V environments.

The Windows-specific expectation should therefore be moved to a
Windows-only test file, similar to the existing
`volumes_linux_test.go` / `volumes_windows_test.go` split in `pkg/specgen`.

Once that test is separated, the skip entry can be narrowed to
`pkg/bindings/test`, allowing the other unit tests under `pkg/bindings`
to run normally in CI.
